tool.name: Invert boolean parameter

expand.label: If the input is unset (null)
expand.help: Treating an unset input as false makes the result true, and the other way round.

tool.help:
**What it does**
Returns the opposite of a boolean (logical NOT). Use it in a workflow to run a step when a condition is *not* met, for example to connect it to the ``when`` input of the step that handles the "else" branch.
**Truth table**
============ ============================================================== Input Result ============ ============================================================== true false false true unset (null) the job fails (default); true if unset is treated as false; false if unset is treated as true ============ ==============================================================
